reviewFindings.title: Rate limiter storage is single-node only
reviewFindings.detail: Reviewer found request budgets stored in process memory, so multiple application instances would not share rate-limit state.
reviewFindings.recommendation: Introduce a storage adapter so the middleware can swap from local memory to Redis or another shared store before production deployment.
evidence: L27: private readonly buckets = new Map<string, BucketState>();

reviewFindings.title: Validation DSL is intentionally narrower than full JSON Schema
reviewFindings.detail: Reviewer found a focused field-rule DSL rather than a full schema engine, which keeps the worked example readable but narrows the shape of supported schemas.
reviewFindings.recommendation: Expand the validator or plug in a full schema engine if future specs need nested schemas or broader composition features.

reviewFindings.title: Refresh-token revocation is not persisted
reviewFindings.detail: Reviewer found a refresh flow but no session registry or token revocation layer, so individual refresh sessions cannot be invalidated once issued.
reviewFindings.recommendation: Add a persistent session or token registry if the auth module moves beyond the current scoped challenge environment.
